Frozen Strawberry Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, March 13, 2010 - 12:30am

Ingredients




2 2/3 cups crushed pretzels
1 stick plus 3 tbsp. butter
3 tablespoons sugar
1 sm. Cool Whip, thawed
1 cup sugar
1 (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
1 lg. pkg. strawberry Jello
2 cups boiling water
1 lg. box frozen strawberries

Preparation

1 Combine first 3 ingredients and press into 9x13 inch glass dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes and cool. 2 Combine softened Cool Whip and cream cheese with sugar and spread over cooled crust. 3 Prepare Jello and add strawberries to hot Jello. When slightly cooled, spread over salad and set.
